opening: I feel lightheaded and dizzy or faint.
I've noticed light red blood or blood clots in my stool.
I'm quite short of breath; it's hard to breathe.
I'm tired all the time or my sleep isn't restful.
I'm taking one of the new oral blood thinners (a NOAC).
Someone in my family has been diagnosed with anemia.

opening.text: I'm here because I feel lightheaded, dizzy, or like I'm about to faint. I've also noticed light red blood or blood clots in my stool. I'm quite short of breath and find it hard to breathe, plus I'm tired all the time or my sleep isn't restful. I'm taking one of the new oral blood thinners, a NOAC. I have a poor diet, and someone in my family has been diagnosed with anemia.
